title.zh: 材料选择：刻掉谁，保住谁
title.en: Material selection: what to remove and what to protect

subtitle.zh: 目标层、掩膜、停止层与暴露材料。
subtitle.en: Target layer, mask, stop layer and exposed materials

body.zh: 核心判断；选择比要写清材料对。S = 目标材料刻蚀速率 ÷ 被保护材料刻蚀速率；；相同条件下，S越大，去除相同目标厚度时，被保护材料通常损失越少。
body.en: Core assessment Specify the material pair: S = target-material etch rate ÷ protected-material etch rate Under identical conditions, higher S generally means less protected-material loss for the same target thickness removed

body.zh: 流程位置；在刻蚀前匹配材料堆栈、掩膜和化学体系，保证刻穿目标层后仍有保护余量。
body.en: Position in the flow Match the stack, mask and chemistry before etching so protection remains after clearing the target

body.zh: 选材流程；1；列出所有；暴露材料
body.en: Material-selection flow 1 List all exposed materials

body.zh: 材料堆栈与选择比示意；刻蚀气体 / 液体；掩膜（如SiO₂）；目标层（如Si）；停止层（如Si₃N₄）；衬底
body.en: Material stack and selectivity Etch gas / liquid Mask (e.g. SiO₂) Target layer (e.g. Si) Stop layer (e.g. Si₃N₄) Substrate

body.zh: 刻蚀速率与选择比；对掩膜；S_target/mask；对停止层；S_target/stop；S越大，；被保护材料损失越少。
body.en: Etch rate and selectivity Relative to mask S_target/mask Relative to stop layer S_target/stop As S increases, protected-material loss decreases

body.zh: 过刻导致薄弱处穿透（风险示意）；正常刻穿目标层；停止层仍有余量；目标层已去除；停止层未穿透
body.en: Overetch penetrates weak locations (risk schematic) Normally clear the target with stop-layer margin remaining Target layer removed Stop layer intact

body.zh: 过刻继续消耗；导致停止层穿透；过刻后停止层变薄；甚至被穿透
body.en: Continued consumption during overetch causes stop-layer breakthrough Overetch thins the stop layer and may penetrate it

body.zh: 关键控制；对掩膜选择比；对停止层选择比；其他暴露层损失；过刻余量
body.en: Key controls Selectivity to mask Selectivity to stop layer Loss of other exposed layers Overetch margin

body.zh: 耦合与失效；• 为清除最难刻区域而延长过刻，；会继续消耗已暴露的保护层。；•可能造成掩膜耗尽、停止层穿透；或邻近材料被腐蚀。
body.en: Coupling and failure • Extending overetch to clear the hardest-to-etch regions continues consuming exposed protective layers • This may exhaust the mask, break through the stop layer or corrode nearby materials

body.zh: 量测反馈；刻前；刻后；比较刻前刻后；各层厚度，结合；截面检查最薄位置；；据此评估掩膜厚度、；停止方案和过刻安排。；反馈优化选材与工艺
body.en: Metrology feedback Before etch After etch Compare pre/post-etch layer thicknesses and inspect the thinnest cross-sectional locations; use this to assess mask thickness, stopping strategy and overetch planning Feedback optimizes materials and processing

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；• 保护层损失可能影响隔离和可靠性。；• 湿法与干法均可实现高选择性，数值取决于材料对、膜质和工艺条件。；• HF/BOE去氧化硅、热磷酸去氮化硅是常见湿法例子，仍须核对其余材料兼容性。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries • Protective-layer loss can affect isolation and reliability • Both wet and dry etching can achieve high selectivity; values depend on the material pair, film quality and conditions • HF/BOE oxide removal and hot-phosphoric-acid nitride removal are common wet examples; still check compatibility with other materials
